entities.summary: Roman Empire, a political institution in Syria during Hellenistic and Roman Syria (64 BCE–636). Grew from Antioch founded — becomes one of the four great cities of the ancient world and Maccabean. Led to the emergence of Byzantine and Queen Zenobia of Palmyra briefly conquers Egypt and much of the Roman East.
